Loss report: gitlab -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/.shared display.name (the Woodpecker workflow name is its file name; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/.shared/job/run job.if (no trigger of the pipeline has a Woodpecker event; the workflow never runs)
[lost] pipeline/.shared/job/run job.runner (only a platform label has a Woodpecker form (labels.platform); other labels are lost)
[lost] pipeline/.shared/trigger/0 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gha (event) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/.shared/trigger/0 trigger.api (Woodpecker starts API pipelines as manual events)
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (the Woodpecker workflow name is its file name; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner (only a platform label has a Woodpecker form (labels.platform); other labels are lost)
[emulated] pipeline/.shared/job/run job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci project.multi_pipeline: each job of each pipeline is a workflow named <pipeline>-<job> (each workflow carries its pipeline's trigger condition)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
